role_sought: Member of the Parliament of the Canton of Jura
detail: Elected to the Jura cantonal parliament for the Socialist Party (after serving earlier as a substitute deputy from age 30). Re-elected in 1998; presided over the chamber in 2000.

role_sought: Member of the Jura cantonal government (Conseil d'État)
detail: Elected to the Jura cantonal executive, taking office in 2002/2003; re-elected in 2006 and 2010. Did not stand again in 2015.

election: Federal election (Council of States), canton of Jura
role_sought: Member of the Council of States for Jura
detail: Returned to politics and won a Council of States seat with the canton's best result, ahead of Charles Juillard.

role_sought: Member of the Federal Council (succeeding Simonetta Sommaruga)
opponent: Eva Herzog (SP, 116 votes); Daniel Jositsch (SP, 6 votes)
detail: On the official SP ticket alongside Eva Herzog. Led the first round (96 votes vs 83) to general surprise; in the third round elected by 123 votes to 116 for Herzog. First Federal Councillor from the canton of Jura.
Re-elected to the Federal Council with 151 votes during the full renewal following the 2023 federal elections.
